name: MSI laptop (WMI v2, read-only beta)
note: Every 11th-gen+ MSI laptop. Addresses are the fixed ones MSI Center itself uses on all WMI2 models and match msi-ec layouts G2_0-G2_10. Read-only until testers confirm them (see docs/research/wmi2-msi-acpi.md).

shiftMode.note: EC 0xD2 (WMI1: 0xF2). Same codes as WMI1 laptops (MSI Center's WMI2 code and msi-ec G2 layouts).

fanMode.note: EC 0xD4 (WMI1: 0xF4). auto 0x0D / silent 0x1D per msi-ec. A custom curve is bit 7 per msi-ec (advanced, 0x8D) but bit 6 with bit 7 clear in MSI Center's own code (advancedMsi, 0x4D). The wizard's fan-curve check finds out which one this laptop follows; the app only uses 'advanced' once a model is verified.

kbdBacklight.note: EC 0xD3 low 2 bits (WMI1: 0xF3). Not present on every WMI2 model.

chargeLimit.note: EC 0xD7 (WMI1: 0xEF): bit 7 kept, low 7 bits = percent (MSI uses 100/80/60).

cpuTemp.note: EC 0x68, same as WMI1 (msi-ec G2 rt_temp).

cpuFan.note: EC 0x71 fan duty, same as WMI1 (msi-ec G2 rt_fan_speed).

gpuFan.note: EC 0x89 fan duty, same as WMI1.

cpuFanTachHi.note: Get_Fan(0) byte 0: CPU tachometer high byte (MSI: rpm = 480000 / raw).

cpuFanTachLo.note: Get_Fan(0) byte 1: CPU tachometer low byte.

gpuFanTachHi.note: Get_Fan(0) byte 2: GPU tachometer high byte.

gpuFanTachLo.note: Get_Fan(0) byte 3: GPU tachometer low byte.

cpuCurveTemp0.note: CPU curve temperature: EC 0x69-0x6E as on WMI1 (unconfirmed on WMI2).

cpuCurveSpeed0.note: CPU curve speed point 0: Get_Fan(1) byte 1, written with Set_Fan(1) like MSI Center (the EC address stays hidden). Unconfirmed until a tester's fan-curve check passes.

gpuCurveTemp0.note: GPU curve temperature: EC 0x81-0x86 as on WMI1 (unconfirmed on WMI2).

gpuCurveSpeed0.note: GPU curve speed point 0: Get_Fan(2) byte 1, written with Set_Fan(2) like MSI Center (the EC address stays hidden). Unconfirmed until a tester's fan-curve check passes.
